status: source-code-inspected; no native Chromium or new runtime contract executed

Q02: b11-place-start logs the guess and alignment but automatically assembles addends into counts for '+'; not an event for each added bundle.
b11-remove logs actual column index, full before counts and the requested quantity for '-' even when no exchange occurs.
Current placeBinding explicitly permits tensmove only at index 3; it permits no hundredsmove position.
Current replayPlaceEvidence requires at least one successful exchange; no-regrouping paths in these six tasks cannot inherit it as-is.
Do not insert gratuitous exchange and reverse-exchange solely to satisfy a proof check. If no event demonstrates required learning, do not claim it.
Q03: Original a30-transform only toggles the board's transformed flag and changes displayed, pre-authored before/after geometry; there are no freehand cut/translate/rotate actions.
a30-part records a field and the currently selected preset piece identity. These tasks each supply a single piece.
Current areaBinding's reviewed SOURCE set includes other pieces but excludes triArea:0..3; replayAreaEvidence also restricts geometry by exact native sources.
triArea:3 task points include irrational Math.sqrt(11); existing exact polygon helper assumes integer coordinates. Correct 50 alone is not an exact construction witness.
The original grader's correctness and optional prose are preserved, but correctness does not certify an independently built proof.

requiredBeforeImplementation: Read latest main and current original module before freezing taskFingerprint(task), source ID and browser action grammar.
Write separate independent math replay, only for operations truly performed and recorded, preserving wrong-first, current submission, strict source and bridge/practice rejection.
Do not modify original task, grading, learning history or State-v2 merely to manufacture A evidence.
Targeted Node negatives first; use applicable native Chromium/P10/State-v2/offline CI only after an actual implementation PR.

releaseAndPrepush.existingTool: scripts/ci-release-sync.mjs (already on main; no duplicate script added)
existingCoverage: all reviewed navigation fixture hashes for dist/learning/learn.js
safe release-only sync; rejects non-release learn.js edits and stale unexpected fixture hashes
releaseAndPrepush.whenReleaseChanged: For purely release identity changes: node scripts/ci-release-sync.mjs sync --release math-explorer-<explicit-version>, inspect the diff, rerun check and its test. Non-release learn.js edits require deliberate fixture re-review rather than silent sync.
releaseAndPrepush.rationale: PR #299 stale learn.js fixture hashes were already addressed by the existing #268 sync/check tool and its CI test; adding a second preflight implementation would duplicate it. CI on PR and independent main remains required.
